---
title: Installation
---

FPsim requires a working Python environment (Python 3.10 or later).

## Install from PyPI

For most users, install the latest release with:

```
pip install fpsim
```

You should then be able to import FPsim:

```
python -c "import fpsim as fp; print(fp.__version__)"
```

## Install from source

To modify FPsim, or to work from the development version, clone the repository and
install it in editable mode:

```
git clone https://github.com/fpsim/fpsim.git
cd fpsim
pip install -e .
```

To run the tests and build the documentation as well, install the development extras:

```
pip install -e .[dev]
```
